I don’t know whether the renewal was ultimately finalized. The latest correspondence I found, from November 18, still had Orbitly reviewing the offer with procurement and a follow-up call planned for November 24 [2].

- Orbitly asked for **15% off**; Sam offered **8% off on a two-year term**, plus quarterly invoicing. Jonas said 8% was below their expectations [1][2].
- EU data residency was offered only as a 2027 roadmap item, without a committed date [2].
- Orbitly also requested an SLA credit for the November 12 incident; Sam said he would check the terms with finance [4].

I searched for Orbitly’s renewal, pricing, discount and November 24 follow-up, and read the renewal email, call notes and deal-desk discussion. I found no later agreement [1][2][3].
